verdict.rationale: Box provides webhooks and an events feed that let developers subscribe to file/folder events and trigger external endpoints (box-docs-7, box-docs-19, box-docs-22), which is the building block for event-triggered automation. However, there's no evidence of a native rules/workflow engine (e.g., Box Relay) where a user can declaratively define 'on event X do action Y' inside Box itself — automation requires building and hosting your own webhook receiver and logic. Missing for 10: a documented native rule-definition/workflow-automation feature, and any evidence of built-in conditional actions triggered without external code.
